conn.title: Database connection
conn.hint: Enter the main machine's address and the database name. It is saved once and asked again only if it fails.

lang.intro: Type something in the fields, then switch language: the direction flips at once and nothing you typed is lost.
lang.name: Company name

sessions.intro: Log in from this PC and from a second one. Sessions never exceed the licensed copies, even when both PCs log in at the same moment.

grid.intro: Rows are generated and totalled inside Postgres; the grid draws only the visible rows and fetches them page by page.

windows.intro: Each function opens in its own window. The app won't quit while windows are open.
windows.second_body: This is a second window, running independently of the main one.

msg.DBC-01: There is no database connection. Enter the connection details.
msg.DBC-02: Could not connect to the database. Check the address, database name and login.
msg.LOG-04: You can't log in to Zain Soft because the number of licensed copies has been exceeded.
msg.HOME-02: There are open windows that must be closed before quitting.
msg.CFG-ERR: Could not save this PC's settings.
